title: 第1章 相亲奇葩男第2章 被迫领证
lines: 第1章相亲奇葩男
咖啡厅，夏天笑眼眯眯看着对面的男人，听着他侃侃而谈。
这是她第十八次相亲，此时她已经开始崩溃。
突然，对方又开口了。
“你不知道，现在女孩子，就喜欢打扮的花枝招展的，而且还不务实。夏小姐，你说要是跟这样的女孩子结婚，以后还不得指望我赚钱养着她？”
“还是像夏小姐这样有自己独立经济的好，到时候你自己花钱也方便不是。”
“……”夏天一脸懵逼。
“所以，我对夏小姐很有好感，我们商量下结婚的日子吧！”
没错，夏天在相亲，而且就是眼前这个滔滔不绝而且自以为是的男人。
夏天喝了一口白开水，表示需要压压惊。
“我知道夏小姐对我也很满意的，毕竟像我这么优秀，而且有房有车的男人很少了。”
夏天很想说，你究竟是哪来的自信？有房有车她自己不就有？
只是夏天的话还没有出口，肩膀却被人搂住。
“不好意思，我老婆对你很不满意。”
相亲男看了看夏天，在看了看她身后的那个男人。
手中的杯子猛地一摔，水溅了一桌。
气得脸都快扭曲了。“你们这是耍着我好玩儿？你结婚了出来相什么亲？神经病吗？”
“夏小姐，我没有想到你这样的人，再见，不，再也不见。”
其实，夏天也是很想说，再也不见。
同时也是松了口气，这人终于走了。
“谢谢你啊！”本想好好的谢谢帮再见解围的这个男人，却不想当她看清身后的人之时，有种想钻进地底下的冲动。
“是你啊！”不敢与这个男人直视，端着桌上的杯子喝了口水，以此来掩饰她慌乱的心。
“那我，我先走了，再见。”其实夏天也很想要补一句，再也不见，但是奈何她没有胆子说出来啊。
夏天刚刚站起，想要朝外面走，便被一直没有说话的权天睿直接给拉了回来。
“相亲？”
只是两个字，却包含怒意，夏天又怎么听不出来？
“恩，相亲，虽然很感谢你帮我解围，只是不关先生的事，请让我离开。”
虽然很感谢有人跟自己解围，但绝对不是这个男人，话里明显也多了几分火药味。
夏天这呛人的模样，惹得权天睿那深邃的眼眸之中聚满了怒意。
“很好，看来你想要嫁人了，我成全你。”
权天睿直接忽视了她那没有半点真诚的谢谢，咬牙切齿的看着夏天，恨不得将这个小女人直接给撕了。
言罢，也不等夏天有所反应，直接一个横抱将椅子上的夏天抱起。
“啊……你要做什么。”夏天也没有想到权天睿会这样胆大的举动，顿时惊喊了起来。
权天睿脚下的步子一顿，看着夏天，将她所有的反抗，都一一压制住。
“干什么？娶你。”
也不管咖啡厅里那些一脸震惊的看着他们两个人，这求婚的方式是不是有点太霸道了？
content_en:
Chapter 1 Blind date with a strange man
In the coffee shop, Xia Tian looked at the man opposite with a smile and listened to his talk.
This was her eighteenth blind date, and by this time she was beginning to collapse.
Suddenly, the other party spoke again.
"You don't know that girls these days like to dress up and show off, and they are not pragmatic. Miss Xia, do you think that if you marry such a girl, you can't expect me to make money to support her in the future?"
"It's better to have your own independent finances like Miss Xia. Then it won't be convenient for you to spend your own money."
"..." Xia Tian looked confused.
"So, I have a good impression of Miss Xia. Let's discuss a wedding date!"
That's right, Xia Tian was on a blind date, and it was this gushing and self-righteous man in front of her.
Xia Tian took a sip of boiled water, indicating that he needed to calm down.
"That..."
"I know Miss Xia is also very satisfied with me. After all, there are very few men as good as me who own houses and cars."
Xia Tian really wants to say, where do you get your confidence from? Doesn’t she have a house and a car herself?
But before Xia Tian's words could be spoken, someone hugged his shoulders.
"Sorry, my wife is very dissatisfied with you."
The blind date man looked at Xia Tian and then at the man behind her.
The cup in his hand slammed down and water splashed all over the table.
"Bang..."
His face was almost twisted with anger. "Are you just kidding me? Why are you going on a blind date after you get married? Are you crazy?"
"Miss Xia, I didn't expect someone like you. Goodbye, no, never see you again."
In fact, Xia Tian also wanted to say, never see her again.
At the same time, he was relieved that this man was finally gone.
"Thank you!" She wanted to express her gratitude to the man who helped her see her surroundings, but she didn't want to feel the urge to crawl into the ground when she saw the person behind her clearly.
"It's you!" She didn't dare to look directly at the man, and took a sip of water from the cup on the table to hide her panic.
"Then I, I'm leaving first, goodbye." In fact, Xia Tian also wanted to add, "Never see you again," but she didn't have the courage to say it.
Xia Tian just stood up and wanted to walk outside, but was pulled back directly by Quan Tianrui, who had been silent.
"Blind date?"
It's just two words, but it contains anger. Why can't Xia Tian hear it?
"Well, blind date. Although I appreciate you helping me out, it's none of your business, sir. Please let me leave."
Although I was very grateful for someone to help me out, it was definitely not this man, and his words were obviously a little more explosive.
Xia Tian's choking look made Quan Tianrui's deep eyes filled with anger.
"Very good. It seems that you want to get married. I will make it happen for you."
Quan Tianrui ignored her insincere thank you and looked at Xia Tian with gritted teeth, wishing to tear this little woman apart.
After saying that, without waiting for Xia Tian to react, he directly picked up Xia Tian on the chair in a horizontal hug.
"Ah...what are you going to do?" Xia Tian didn't expect Quan Tianrui to make such a bold move, and suddenly screamed.
Quan Tianrui paused, looked at Xia Tian, ​​and suppressed all her resistance one by one.
"What for? Marry you."
Regardless of the people in the coffee shop who looked at the two of them in shock, was this way of proposing a little too overbearing?
